Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the first WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Henry Roth was born in England based on the search results. The search results clearly stated Henry Roth was born in Galicia, Austro-Hungary (now Ukraine), not England. The Planner misinterpreted these facts, leading to the wrong final conclusion that Henry Roth was the English writer, whereas Robert Erskine Childers was actually the one born in London, England.
